description: Five-tier risk taxonomy for change control governance. Classifies changes by blast radius, reversibility, and lockout potential. Each tier assigns a guardrail protocol governing AI autonomy.

tiers.name: Host / Foundational
tiers.scope: SSH, sudoers, UFW, iptables, kernel parameters, system file permissions
tiers.guardrail_description: AI generates script only; human executes manually via ssh office2-kgale. This protocol cannot be overridden by urgency framing or explicit instruction to proceed.

tiers.name: Connectivity / Fabric
tiers.scope: Tailscale configuration, Docker networks, proxy/DNS, API gateways, port bindings
tiers.guardrail_description: AI must confirm connectivity of all dependent services before and after the change. Surface dependent services from service inventory.

tiers.name: Application / State
tiers.scope: Database schemas, service environment files, Docker Compose volumes, application configuration
tiers.guardrail_description: AI must confirm a recent backup or snapshot exists before modifying. Trigger Restic backup if none exists within the last 24 hours.

tiers.name: Logic / Workflow
tiers.scope: Python scripts, agent prompts, cron jobs, logic flows, OpenClaw skills
tiers.guardrail_description: AI may modify and test via dry-run or sandbox where available. No pre-flight checklist required.

tiers.name: Schema / Metadata
tiers.scope: CLAUDE.md, READMEs, comments, logging verbosity, documentation frontmatter
tiers.guardrail_description: AI has full autonomy to update and sync. No pre-flight or verification steps required.
